questions.title: Streaming Media Track
questions.prompt:
Create a class `MusicTrack` in `MusicTrack.java`:
* **Private fields:** `String trackTitle`, `String artist`, `int durationSeconds`, `int playCount`.
* **Constructor 1:** `MusicTrack(String trackTitle, String artist, int durationSeconds, int playCount)`.
* **Constructor 2:** `MusicTrack(String trackTitle, String artist)` which sets `durationSeconds = 180` and `playCount = 0`.
* **Getters and Setters:** For all four fields.
  * In `setDurationSeconds(int seconds)`: If `seconds < 1`, set to `1`.
  * In `setPlayCount(int count)`: If `count < 0`, set to `0`.
questions.expectedOutput:
Hail Purdue by Purdue Band [180s] Plays: 0
Updated: [1s] Plays: 0

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: Default constructor fields; duration lower clamp (1s); negative play count clamp (0).

tests.name: Test 3 [Hidden] (Positive Updates)
tests.description: Setting valid seconds (240) and plays (1500) updates correctly.

tests.name: Test 5 [Hidden] (String Mutators)
tests.description: Title and artist setters update fields.

questions.testerExpectedOutput:
Hail Purdue by Purdue Band [180s] Plays: 0
Updated: [1s] Plays: 0

questions.title: GPS Coordinate Waypoint
questions.prompt:
Create a class `Waypoint` in `Waypoint.java`:
* **Private fields:** `String label`, `double latitude`, `double longitude`.
* **Constructor:** `Waypoint(String label, double latitude, double longitude)`.
* **`toString()`:** Return:
  ```
  Waypoint: <label>
  Lat: <latitude formatted to 4 decimal places>
  Lon: <longitude formatted to 4 decimal places>
  ```
  *(Separated by `\n` with no trailing newline)*
* **`equals(Object o)`:** Two waypoints are equal if their coordinates are approximately equal: `Math.abs(latitude - o.latitude) < 0.0001` AND `Math.abs(longitude - o.longitude) < 0.0001`, regardless of label. Return `false` if `o` is `null` or not a `Waypoint`.
questions.expectedOutput:
Waypoint: Bell Tower
Lat: 40.4275
Lon: -86.9170
Close enough: true

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: 4 decimal place formatting; coordinate proximity equality test (<0.0001).

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (Exact 0.0001 Difference Boundary)
tests.description: Exactly 0.0001 difference returns false (must be strictly < 0.0001).

questions.testerExpectedOutput:
Waypoint: Bell Tower
Lat: 40.4275
Lon: -86.9170
Close enough: true

questions.title: Industrial Pressure Relief
questions.prompt:
Create an unchecked exception `OverpressureException` in `OverpressureException.java` extending `RuntimeException` with a constructor taking `String message`.

In `BoilerValve.java`, write:
`public static int adjustPressure(int currentPSI, int deltaPSI, int safeLimitPSI) throws OverpressureException`
* If `deltaPSI == 0`, throw `IllegalArgumentException` with message: `"Pressure change cannot be zero"`.
* If `currentPSI + deltaPSI > safeLimitPSI`, throw `OverpressureException` with message:
  `"Rupture hazard: PSI reached <currentPSI + deltaPSI>, limit is <safeLimitPSI>"`.
* If `currentPSI + deltaPSI < 0`, return `0` (cannot have negative absolute pressure).
* Otherwise, return `currentPSI + deltaPSI`.
questions.expectedOutput:
Pressure: 130 PSI
Rupture hazard: PSI reached 165, limit is 150

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: Successful PSI adjustment followed by OverpressureException.

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (Depressurization to Exactly Zero)
tests.description: Delta reducing PSI exactly to 0 returns 0.

questions.testerExpectedOutput:
Pressure: 130 PSI
Rupture hazard: PSI reached 165, limit is 150

questions.title: Encryptable Communication
questions.prompt:
Create an interface `Encryptable` in `Encryptable.java`:
* Abstract method: `String encrypt(int shift);`
* Abstract method: `String decrypt(int shift);`
* Default method: `default boolean testCipher(int shift)`:
  * Encrypts sample text `"JAVA"`, decrypts the result with the same shift, and returns `true` if the decrypted text equals `"JAVA"`, else `false`.

Create a class `CaesarCipher` in `CaesarCipher.java` implementing `Encryptable`:
* **Private field:** `String message`.
* **Constructor:** `CaesarCipher(String message)`.
* Implement `encrypt(int shift)`: shifts only uppercase alphabetic letters (`'A'` - `'Z'`) forward cyclically by `shift` positions. Non-uppercase letters remain unchanged.
* Implement `decrypt(int shift)`: shifts uppercase letters backward cyclically by `shift` positions (`shift` is positive).
* You may assume `shift` is between 1 and 25.

*(Note: `testCipher` constructs its own `CaesarCipher("JAVA")` internally to validate the round-trip.)*
questions.expectedOutput:
Encrypted: KHOOR
Decrypted: HELLO
Cipher Valid: true

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: Caesar shift of 3 forward ("HELLO" -> "KHOOR") and backward, verifying default method.

tests.name: Test 4 [Hidden] (Non-Uppercase Characters)
tests.description: Spaces and punctuation like "HI!" keep "!" unchanged ("KL!").

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (Polymorphic Reference)
tests.description: Interface reference Encryptable e = new CaesarCipher("TEST"); works seamlessly.

questions.testerExpectedOutput:
Encrypted: KHOOR
Decrypted: HELLO
Cipher Valid: true

questions.title: Residential Utility Accounts
questions.prompt:
Create a class `UtilityAccount` in `UtilityAccount.java`:
* **Protected fields:** `String accountNumber`, `double usageUnits`.
* **Constructor:** `UtilityAccount(String accountNumber, double usageUnits)`.
* Method `calculateBill()` returning `usageUnits * 1.20`.

Create subclass `WaterAccount` in `WaterAccount.java` extending `UtilityAccount`:
* **Private field:** `double stormWaterFee`.
* **Constructor:** `WaterAccount(String accountNumber, double usageUnits, double stormWaterFee)` calling `super`.
* Override `calculateBill()`:
  * Water rate is `$0.80` per unit (instead of $1.20).
  * Bill = `(usageUnits * 0.80) + stormWaterFee`.
  * If `usageUnits > 100.0`, add a conservation tier surcharge of `$25.00`.

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: Generic account, standard water account, high-usage water account (>100 units).

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (Super Constructor)
tests.description: Account number and usage units initialized through super.

questions.title: Package Delivery Dispatch
questions.prompt:
Given base class `Parcel` with method `double getShippingCost()` and subclass `InsuredParcel` (which overrides `getShippingCost()` adding an insurance premium), implement `DispatchManager.java`:
* `public static double computeTotalShipping(Parcel[] packages)`:
  * Sums `getShippingCost()` for all non-null parcels.
  * If `packages` is `null` or empty, return `0.0`.
* `public static int countExpressShipments(Parcel[] packages, double expressCostThreshold)`:
  * Counts non-null parcels where `getShippingCost() >= expressCostThreshold`.
  * If `packages` is `null`, return `0`.

*(The autograder provides `Parcel` and `InsuredParcel`.)*

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: Sums parcels and insured parcels skipping null; checks threshold.

tests.name: Test 4 [Hidden] (Exact Threshold Match)
tests.description: Parcel with cost == threshold is counted.

tests.name: Test 5 [Hidden] (All Insured Parcels)
tests.description: Overridden dynamic dispatch verified across array.

questions.title: Server Uptime CSV Log
questions.prompt:

questions.title: Blood Donor Eligibility Filter
questions.prompt:
In `DonorRegistry.java`, write:
`public static int exportEligibleDonors(String inputFile, String outputFile, int minAge, double minWeightLbs)`
* `inputFile` format: `DonorName;Age;WeightLbs`
* Eligible donors must satisfy: `Age >= minAge` AND `WeightLbs >= minWeightLbs`.
* Write to `outputFile`, one per line:
  `DONOR: <DonorName> (Age: <Age>, Wt: <WeightLbs>)`
* Return total eligible donors written.
* If `inputFile` is missing, catch `IOException`, print `"Donor file error"`, and return `-1`.

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: Filters on both age and weight constraints.

tests.name: Test 2 [Hidden] (Exact Age and Weight Boundaries)
tests.description: Donor with Age == minAge and WeightLbs == minWeightLbs is included.

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (Fails One Criteria Only)
tests.description: Validates logical AND (passing age but failing weight is excluded).

tests.name: Test 7 [Hidden] (File Overwrite)
tests.description: Existing target file truncated and replaced.

questions.title: Parking Garage Structure
questions.prompt:
Create abstract class `ParkingPermit` in `ParkingPermit.java`:
* **Protected fields:** `String permitHolder`, `int semesterWeeks`.
* **Constructor:** `ParkingPermit(String permitHolder, int semesterWeeks)`.
* **Abstract method:** `public abstract double calculatePermitCost();`

Create subclass `CommuterPermit` in `CommuterPermit.java`:
* **Constructor:** `CommuterPermit(String permitHolder, int semesterWeeks)`.
* Cost: `$25.00` per week (`semesterWeeks * 25.0`).

Create subclass `GaragePermit` in `GaragePermit.java`:
* **Private field:** `boolean coveredParking`.
* **Constructor:** `GaragePermit(String permitHolder, int semesterWeeks, boolean coveredParking)` using `super`.
* Cost:

  * If `coveredParking` is `true`, add a flat roof protection surcharge of `$75.00`.
  * If `semesterWeeks >= 16`, apply a full-semester rebate: subtract `$30.00` from the final cost.

tests.name: Test 2 [Hidden] (15-Week Garage)

tests.name: Test 5 [Hidden] (Zero Weeks)
tests.description: 0 weeks returns 0.0 (or surcharge without rebate for garage).

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (Polymorphic Reference)
tests.description: Array of ParkingPermit objects evaluated dynamically.

tests.name: Test 7 [Hidden] (Super Constructor Call)
tests.description: Super fields holder and weeks initialized properly.

questions.title: Nuclear Reactor Cooling Loop
questions.prompt:
Simulate reactor core stabilization in `ReactorCore.java`. Core starts at `Core Temp: 350` C with `Coolant Level: 100`%.

Each round: print `Temp: <temp>C | Coolant: <coolant>%`, display menu:
`1) Normal Circulation (+10C, -5% Coolant)  2) Inject Boron (-40C, -20% Coolant)  3) Flush Heat Sink (-25C)  4) Safe SCRAM & Exit`
* `1`: Temp increases by 10C, Coolant drops by 5%.
* `2`: Inject Boron: If Coolant < 20%, print `Insufficient coolant for Boron injection!`. Otherwise, deduct 20% coolant and decrease temp by 40C.
* `3`: Flush Heat Sink: Temp decreases by 25C (no coolant used).
* `4`: Print `SCRAM successful. Reactor in cold shutdown at <temp>C.` and terminate.
* **Any other input:** Print `Control rod failure! Warning.` and add 20C to temp.
* **Critical Failures:**
  * If Temp reaches `500C` or higher at any time, immediately print `CRITICAL ALARM: Meltdown imminent! Containment sealed.` and terminate.
  * If Coolant drops to `0%` or below, immediately print `COOLANT LOSS: Meltdown imminent! Containment sealed.` and terminate.

Read menu choices from standard input with a `Scanner`.
questions.expectedOutput:
Temp: 350C | Coolant: 100%
1) Normal Circulation (+10C, -5% Coolant)  2) Inject Boron (-40C, -20% Coolant)  3) Flush Heat Sink (-25C)  4) Safe SCRAM & Exit
Temp: 360C | Coolant: 95%
1) Normal Circulation (+10C, -5% Coolant)  2) Inject Boron (-40C, -20% Coolant)  3) Flush Heat Sink (-25C)  4) Safe SCRAM & Exit
Temp: 320C | Coolant: 75%
1) Normal Circulation (+10C, -5% Coolant)  2) Inject Boron (-40C, -20% Coolant)  3) Flush Heat Sink (-25C)  4) Safe SCRAM & Exit
Temp: 295C | Coolant: 75%
1) Normal Circulation (+10C, -5% Coolant)  2) Inject Boron (-40C, -20% Coolant)  3) Flush Heat Sink (-25C)  4) Safe SCRAM & Exit
SCRAM successful. Reactor in cold shutdown at 295C.

tests.name: Test 1 [Visible] (Sample Run)
tests.description: Normal circulation, boron injection, heat sink flush, successful SCRAM exit.

tests.name: Test 2 [Hidden] (Meltdown at 500C)
tests.description: Temp reaching exactly 500C triggers meltdown alarm and halts immediately.

tests.name: Test 4 [Hidden] (Coolant Loss at 0%)
tests.description: Depleting coolant to exactly 0% triggers coolant loss alarm and halts.

tests.name: Test 5 [Hidden] (Insufficient Coolant for Boron)
tests.description: Coolant at 15% attempting Boron injection is rejected without altering temp or coolant.

tests.name: Test 6 [Hidden] (Rod Failure Spike)
tests.description: Invalid menu command increases temperature by 20C.

tests.name: Test 7 [Hidden] (Meltdown Caused by Rod Failure)
tests.description: Invalid command pushing temp to >= 500C triggers meltdown immediately.

tests.name: Test 8 [Hidden] (Exact 20% Boron Injection)
tests.description: Injecting Boron with exactly 20% coolant remaining reduces coolant to 0% and triggers coolant loss meltdown.

tests.name: Test 9 [Hidden] (Immediate SCRAM)
tests.description: Option 4 on turn 1 exits safely at 350C.

tests.description: Exact validation against Ed Lessons output standards.
